subject: The 11PM text you should never send
preview_text: Here's the mistake 90% of new users make, and the one feature that fixes it instantly.
body_paragraphs: You know that moment when your stomach drops after hitting send? It's 11PM, you're replaying the conversation in your head, and you just know something is off. That gut feeling is trying to tell you something. But here's what most people get wrong: they ignore it and keep texting, hoping it'll magically fix itself.

The #1 mistake that ruins your results is letting emotion drive your responses in real time. You react before you scan. By the time you realize you've been manipulated, gaslighted, or love bombed, you've already engaged, and the damage is done. I've seen it wreck relationships and trust in days.

That's why Red Flag Scanner AI has a specific feature for this: the 'Scan Before Send' option. Take a screenshot of their last message, paste it into the app, and let the AI show you the toxicity score, pattern breakdown, and red flags before you type a single word. It's like having a protective coach in your pocket who stops you from stepping into a trap.

Open the app right now and scan your most recent conversation. See what you've been missing. P.S. The next email will show you the 3-word text that breaks manipulation loops — and you'll need today's scan to use it.
